title: A wonderful cultural experience
text: We had a lovely evening with Anie. We learned so much about the Catalan culture, history, and neighborhoods in Barcelona. The food and drinks we tried was more than plentiful and absolutely delicious. If you have time to take this tour- do it! You won’t be disappointed.
author: Deb6020

title: Fantastic tapas tour with an amazing guide
text:
We did the Small Group Tapas Tour in Barcelona with our guide Jo, and it was a real highlight of our trip. Jo took us to hidden spots around the city center that we never would have found on our own, and his knowledge was incredible — he wove together the history, architecture, food, and wine of Barcelona in a way that made the whole evening feel like a story, not just a food tour.

The tapas and drinks were delicious and kept coming, and the small group size made it feel personal rather than touristy. If you want to actually understand the local culture of Barcelona while eating and drinking
author: Cosmopolitan777047

title: This was an incredible tour! It felt like visiting a friend and them taking you around their beloved town. Hidden gem,
text: This was an incredible tour! We had a wonderful experience and it was worth every penny. We’d have would have never found some of the hidden gems and learned so much about the history of the traditions and the foods and the culture would highly recommend all of our friends!
author: N1120OCshawns

title: Experienced local cuisine & history. Most enjoyable.
text: Joe was very knowledgeable about  history and architecture. Informative and most pleasant. Each stop offered different specialties to try. It was great to walk for a while and hear Joe’s comments between each stop. We finished the tour overly satiated!!!  Thumbs up‼️

title: Meeting Barcelona!
text: Excellent guide!! Attentive, with a lot of knowledge! I would spend the whole day listening to your knowledge about the city!!! Super Indico!
author: Roberta F

title: A wonderful way to discover Barcelona
text: A fantastic experience! A mixture of history and gastronomy where we have discovered beautiful corners of this wonderful city with Annie, an expert and friendly guide. Super recommended!!
author: stelam288

title: A city tour with great gusto and flavors galore
text: We explored lovely small establishments that we never would have tried on our own. We were introduced to many local dishes and libations.  We dared ourselves to eat outside of our comfort zones and were rewarded with explosions of flavor and understanding of the local food and culture.  They were also able to make adjustments to the menu to meet the needs of my daughter’s dietary restrictions. Savan is an extremely exuberant and knowledgeable guide who loves where he lives and what he does.
author: I316OUkimd

title: The Most Amazing Experience in Barcelona
text: The tour was one of the highlights of our holiday in Spain. Our guide - Sevan - made the experience extremely informative and entertaining for us. The kids particularly had a great time listening to the stories and eating the food. A great part of the tour was that it was not limited to just providing information, but rather it was a conversation where we could engage with Sevan to understand the city and region much better (often through his own perspective and experiences).
author: ArjunC251

title: Like exploring the city with your friends, but better
text: Sevan and Ani went above and beyond to create such a well curated and thoughtful experience that I genuinely feel like I got a true authentic taste of Barcelona from the friendliest people. I traveled solo and did tons of research beforehand, and even then Ani was able to introduce me to so many cool things and increased my appreciation for the culture even more while having so much fun. I absolutely recommend them as your guides to get the best out of this beautiful city!
author: Sightseer58327614450

title: Amazing food, cultural and historical experience
text: Sevan was wonderful. His passion for Barcelona was infectious. He took us to truly local spots, recounted their history, and introduced us to delicious local fare.  He also showed us some local traditions, including drinking special cider straight from the barrel. Sevan tailored the tour specially to our dietary restrictions (which was not easy).  As he took us from one restaurant to the next, he recounted the history of Barcelona and taught us about some of Barcelona’s most famous landmarks.
